resources.name: Monolayer C₂N crystal structure parameters
resources.notes: Hexagonal unit cell with 12 C and 6 N atoms, lattice constant ≈ 8.33 Å. Fully described in Mahmood et al., Nat. Commun. 6, 6486 (2015). The agent constructs the initial geometry from these parameters.
